*** START OF THE PROJECT GUTENBERG EBOOK THE LIGHTHOUSE KEEPER'S ALMANAC ***

CHAPTER I

The keeper climbed the spiral stair each dusk to trim the great lamp,
and the fog horn answered the gulls across the rocks.

CHAPTER II

By morning the cormorants had returned to the harbour wall.
